name: Fenofibrate
description: A peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha agonist approved for severe hypertriglyceridaemia and for mixed dyslipidaemia.

systems.note: Triglyceride reduction through PPAR-alpha agonism; the labelled indication.
Transaminase elevation and, rarely, chronic active hepatitis are labelled.
Reversibly raises serum creatinine without reducing measured filtration; the eGFR reading is misleading.
Myopathy risk, higher when combined with a statin.

monitors.why: The direct index of the effect the drug is given for.
Labelled transaminase elevation and rare chronic active hepatitis.
Reversibly raised without a true fall in filtration; the value must be read against that.
Filtration marker not affected by the creatinine artefact this drug produces.
Myopathy risk, amplified in statin combination.
